objective: Classify the frozen MTL text identity failure of the exact preserved 10 August Landsat-9 staging bytes without reopening the terminal recovery or making an acquisition, promotion, map, or scientific decision.

new_distinct_diagnostic.output_class: sanitized identity classification and append-only receipts only

single_owner_decision_requested.approval_effect: One conditional envelope covering publication of the exact packet, read-only diagnostic implementation and synthetic tests, public default-branch CI, a final no-content preflight, at most one new distinct local diagnostic process, and sanitized terminal publication without intermediate owner reconfirmation while all frozen conditions hold.
allowed_actions_in_dependency_order: Record exact owner approval against the unchanged bundle and proposal hashes. Implement a diagnostic-only script and disposable synthetic tests without opening any real archive, staging file, or Downloads original. Preserve the consumed verifier and recovery attempt unchanged.

Test receipt durability, interruption, source drift, unsafe path/member, missing or duplicate MTL, oversized metadata, malformed values, and secret exposure on disposable fixtures. Publish source-safe packet, approval, code and tests to public main; require successful public CI before any real staged-content read.

Run a final no-content preflight: verify unchanged terminal and post-CI records and four external attempt receipts, exact staged-file metadata and non-reparse status, absence of a prior diagnostic root, and exact public CI. Reserve the new diagnostic receipt identity durably before opening source content.

In one read-only diagnostic process, stream the exact staged file once to remeasure its full SHA-256 and length. Stop before MTL interpretation unless both equal the frozen receipt values. Then inspect TAR headers and read only the exact product-named MTL.txt and MTL.xml regular-file members, with a maximum of 2 MiB each. Do not extract any file or read TIFF member payloads.

For each of LANDSAT_PRODUCT_ID and LANDSAT_SCENE_ID in text and XML, record presence count, syntactic validity, exact equality with the frozen expected value, and only well-formed allowlisted Landsat identifier values. Record fixed failure codes for malformed or arbitrary content; never persist raw MTL text, XML, unknown values, private paths, URLs, or secrets. Write independent append-only terminal and cleanup receipts even if classification fails.

Publish only sanitized terminal classification and exact reconciliation to public main, pass public CI, and stop for a new scientific/source-method decision. A diagnostic pass or mismatch does not automatically change the verifier, source identity, or custody state.
stop_on: Any reviewed proposal, approval, receipt, staged path, staged size, source digest, safety condition, or public CI gate drift.
A missing, unsafe, duplicate, oversized, malformed, or ambiguous MTL member or identity key; an archive-header anomaly; any source mutation during the process.
Any inability to persist the pre-read reservation or terminal/cleanup evidence without exposing private data.
Any request to revise the identity predicate, accept a different scene/product, promote or retry bytes, click an EarthExplorer download, or inspect pixels under this diagnostic-only envelope.

explicit_exclusions: No reuse, resume, reconstruction, retry, or mutation of consumed landsat9-before-20260810-001 or landsat9-before-20260810-recovery-001, including their reserved receipts.
No mutation, relocation, deletion, adoption, or promotion of the preserved staging file or either Downloads original; no browser, network, credential, account, terms, or paid action.

No parser or frozen identity-predicate amendment, source/date/scene substitution, after-product request, TIFF/header/pixel QA, registration, baseline, map generation, change analysis, interpretation, attribution, derived-pixel publication, or scientific publication.
